text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! I'm really sorry about that! I must
not be
focusing enough to have yawned!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Well... I was up all night
yesterday
self-reflecting in my head.
choice_data_list: 眠そうだけど、何かあった？
choice_data_list_en: You look sleepy. Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to understand why I'm always
tripping in
hallways, falling down stairs,
and sliding into
triple backflips down
ramps...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
There was so much to reflect on, I
continued well
until morning... I'm really
sorry I let this happen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Meisho Doto hasn't gotten
enough
sleep.
